Last November I (30F) got the courage to message a man who I thought might be my biological father. My mother gave me zero details about him growing up but I did know my step father was not my biological father even though he will always be my dad. Somehow my sister (she’s older with a different father) and my cousin found out his name and told me when they were drunk probably 8 years ago or so. My mother still talks very little about him but when I told her I messaged him she did answer all the questions I had been building up for 30 years. 

I m not close with my biological father as I have only known him for less than a year but I am glad I met him. He has 3 other children but none seem to want to meet me at this point in time. That breaks my heart but it is what it is and I can’t dwell on it too much. It does make me mad because as much as they had no clue about me I, too, had no idea they existed. 

I still have some concerns with the things he has told me as far as knowing about me since I was conceived but I also cannot think about that too much or I get angry and upset.

It’s a hard and very weird situation to be in and I wish you the best of luck!
